center.rootGoal: Increase the human Center-holder's sovereign capacity by cultivating low-maintenance economic Fruit whose accumulated money, knowledge, infrastructure, capability, and distribution lower the cost of producing subsequent Fruit.
center.direction: Discover or reactivate, cheaply falsify, and cultivate machine-mediated internet capabilities that can acquire, fulfill, and monetize with minimal continuing human labor; search the existing corpus before inventing new organisms.
invariants: No epistemic promotion without accountable evidence.
The organism exists to nourish the human Center-holder; the human does not exist to nourish the organism.
Prefer passive discoverability and automatic fulfillment.
Kill weak branches cheaply before building.
Buyer-context demand evidence does not automatically transfer across humans, enterprises, developers, and autonomous agents.
Independent repeat use and settled value outrank raw transaction, listing, download, or claim counts.
Human identity, KYC, legal, publication, and relationship actions compete for scarce Center-holder attention rather than triggering automatically.
Concrete artifact truth outranks stale planning state.
New habitats trigger a corpus scan before invention.
No debt, hidden obligations, human impersonation, or unauthorized public exposure.

soil.principle: Prefer problems a dominant upstream product is structurally unlikely to solve because the resolution sits outside its core job.
Reject candidates whose resolution collapses to a trivial filter unless another moat such as distribution makes trivial implementation irrelevant.
A Fruit for this Garden should attach to an existing nutrient channel where buyers or machines already search; repeated human outreach is a passivity failure.

Economic reproduction occurs only when later Fruit inherit money, knowledge, infrastructure, code, distribution, or market evidence that lowers the human/capital/uncertainty cost of the next generation.

A newly discovered market, payment rail, or distribution habitat does not justify a new build until existing verified capabilities have been scanned for a fit. Prefer reactivation and reuse when they answer the same transformation.

Problem reality can transfer across buyer types, but willingness-to-pay cannot. Human SaaS demand, developer marketplace demand, enterprise procurement, and autonomous-agent micropayments require separate demand evidence.

Measure demand using independent payer/user breadth, repeat use, settled value, recency, and source-of-truth reconciliation. Raw calls, downloads, listings, or advertised money are insufficient alone.
Human-only boundary actions compete for scarce Center-holder attention. Reaching KYC, legal, public-release, identity, or outreach membranes does not automatically earn an interruption.
Executable artifacts, CI results, settlement receipts, and other concrete evidence outrank older manifests or planning narratives when state conflicts.
Distribution is a vector, not a boolean. Store, API, agentic payments, MCP, CI wrappers, IDE marketplaces, search, and direct installation may occupy different states simultaneously.

When machine-carried evidence is saturated and only human-authorized exposure can resolve the remaining uncertainty, stop adjacent research and feature work; rank the boundary for actuation or park it.

opportunities.name: Google Maps Business → Website Identity Guard
opportunities.thesis: A correct Google Maps business entity can contain a stale, wrong, parent, or unrelated website pointer; downstream contact enrichment can then work perfectly on the wrong entity.
opportunities.moneyFlow: Google Maps scraping and contact enrichment workflows
opportunities.nutrientChannel: Apify / API workflows using Google Maps data
opportunities.passivity: Potentially high if metered machine-to-machine verification
opportunities.reproductivePotential: Could branch into website/contact attribution trust adapters
opportunities.reusableCapability: Maps-to-website identity comparison with fail-closed mismatch classification
opportunities.buyerContextEvidence: Place-detail and enrichment APIs show current machine-paid activity, but direct willingness-to-pay for a pointer-integrity guard remains unresolved.
opportunities.corpusMatch: Direct deterministic Maps→website sampler already exists.
opportunities.lastRationale: First live falsification concluded the thesis is plausible but not yet economically demonstrated; external evidence is still required.
opportunities.epistemicNote: Model reasoning only. Preserved as needs_test, not supported.
